scope: Modeled v15 physical segment geometry, stance bounded by observed hallux onset and third front toe final loaded substep within a grouped physical-contact bout, eight closely related development starts; 8 hallux-only bouts were excluded. Hip forward angle decreasing is the chosen extension proxy, and increasing interior angles are extension proxies for knee/ankle. Segment and joint anatomy, 20 percent phase averaging, tiny contact thresholds and group merging differ from the magpie study. No direct biological validation.
